missing_fact.fact: What the S$1,635.00 FAST credit from Tan Ah Kow's personal account on 09 Sep 2026 was: the owner's own funds (a capital top-up), or customer cash the owner deposited, and if so for which invoice.
missing_fact.question: You transferred S$1,635.00 from your personal account on 9 September with no message. Was that your own money going into the business, or a customer's payment you deposited — and if so, for which invoice?
missing_fact.why_customer_only: The owner initiated the transfer from a personal account; it carries no message and no receipt, chat or note in the book records its purpose.
missing_fact.why_local_cannot_supply: The complete declared inventory holds the bank row and an open customer invoice only; nothing connects them.
